alt: Adrenal gland in cross-section on top of the kidney, with a magnified wedge of the gland wall showing, from outside in: the connective tissue capsule, the zona glomerulosa (rounded nests), the zona fasciculata (long radial cords, the widest zone), the zona reticularis (branching network) and the medulla.
